scope: Chronology of the Azure ML A100 deployment on 2026-10-02 (UTC), including every failure and the fix applied.

steps.result: Job submission failed: storage forced to publicNetworkAccess=Disabled and allowSharedKeyAccess=false by a management-group Azure Policy (modify effect).
steps.fix: Managed VNet (allow_internet_outbound), identity-based system datastores, compute managed identities with Storage Blob Data Contributor; scripts carried in an environment variable because the CLI cannot upload code; results returned through MLflow tags.

steps.what: Long job command (28 KB embedded payload)
steps.result: Batch rejected the task (Bad Request); 20 KB was accepted.
steps.fix: Payload moved to the AXK2_SRC_B64 environment variable.

steps.result: Passed: 694.4 GB in 412 s (1.68 GB/s) from the Hub to private blob; 2-layer cut sha256-verified and built; official FP32 reference computed.
Second node failed with MIGEnabledError (Azure host had MIG enabled) and never joined; cancelled.
AllocationFailed/OutOfCapacity in swedencentral, westus2, francecentral and polandcentral.
steps.fix: Same job queued in six regions with aml/first_capacity_wins.sh; italynorth and uksouth allocated at 17:23Z; uksouth cancelled and its cluster deleted within six minutes so only one cluster billed.

steps.result: Node setup, overlay (21 base files verified, 25 written) and AXK2 registration passed on both nodes; Ray absent from the vLLM 0.23 image.
steps.fix: Install ray[cgraph] before any vLLM process (documented step); job resubmitted onto the warm nodes.

steps.result: Single-node TP8 server healthy, then marlin_gemm 'unsupported a scalar_type' on the first prefill continuing from cached context.
steps.fix: Root cause: on SM80 Marlin repacks FP8 weights into int32 and the MLA chunked-context dtype guard (also in upstream v0.23.0) casts BF16 activations to int32; skip the cast for non-floating weight dtypes (two anchored sites).

steps.result: Passed end to end: rehearsal single-node and two-node, then the full 61-layer model served and tested; job exit status 0.

steps.fix: Series reported as chunked JSON tags; vLLM series recovered by a CPU job reading the private artifacts inside the VNet.

cost_estimate_usd.basis: Retail Spot rates of 2026-10-02 (ND96amsr USD 12.89/node-hour in italynorth/uksouth) x observed allocation windows; Azure invoice may differ.

cleanup: Resource group with all 12 workspaces, storage (including the 694 GB staged copy), key vaults, private endpoints and clusters deleted after the run.
